request: Analyze GSE228869 for PMID 39639402 (Fibro-adipogenic progenitor cells in skeletal muscle unloading: metabolic and functional impairments.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NextSeq 2000) of in vitro expanded, second-passage FAPs from rat m. soleus
final.primary_estimand: Effect of hindlimb-suspension unloading duration (Contr / HS7 / HS14) on the transcriptome of cultured FAPs (time-course LRT, then degPatterns clustering). This is a disuse/unloading estimand; the study contains no exercise, training or reloading arm.
final.sample_inclusion: GEO: 12 libraries = 3 unloading groups x 2 differentiation days x 2 replicates. Paper S2.2.p4: at each time point FAPs from the 8 animals were COMBINED before in vitro expansion, so each group is one pooled isolation; rep1/rep2 are culture replicates of that pool.
planned_contrasts: LRT across Contr/HS7/HS14 (S2.8.p1, S3.6.p1; five clusters of >=30 genes at p.adj<0.01; total DEG count not reported in the text)
HS7 vs Contr and HS14 vs Contr highlighted for PPAR pathway genes (FIG7), no counts reported
final.paper_method: DESeq2 LRT (full ~ unloading time vs reduced ~1; whether differentiation day was in the model is not stated), DEGreport degPatterns, clusterProfiler GSEA
final.paper_results: Cluster 1 cell cycle up in HS7; cluster 2 glycolysis (Eno3, Pfkl, Pgk1, Aldoa, Pkm) increasing; cluster 4 cytokines (Cxcl1, Cxcl3, Cxcl6, Grem2, Wnt5a) up at HS7; cluster 5 PPAR/lipid genes (Pparg, Fabp4, Lpl, Plin1, Acox1, Cpt1c, Rxra, Hmgcs1) down in HS7/HS14

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1-p2: rat hindlimb suspension 7 and 14 d vs vivarium control; S2.2.p4: cells from 8 animals combined per time point before expansion; S2.8.p1: DESeq2 LRT, DEGs at p.adj < 0.01; S3.6.p1: five clusters. No exercise intervention anywhere in Methods; exercise appears only as background (S1.p2, S3.2.p1, S4.p1).

checks: GEO organism Rattus norvegicus, tissue m. soleus, FAPs, Control vs Hindlimb suspension day 0/7/14 matches S2.1/S2.8

ownership.reasoning: The paper deposits exactly this series; the single count table GSE228869_Row_counts_table_faps.txt.gz holds all 12 GEO samples.

alignment.reasoning: inspect: source_name_ch1 equals the 12 matrix column names exactly (12/12). grp = unloading group, diff = adipogenic differentiation day, both parsed from title.

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max 835198, Ensembl rat gene IDs; data_processing: STAR + featureCounts v1.6.4 then DESeq2. Consistent with the paper's input.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the study manipulates disuse only (hindlimb suspension 7/14 d vs vivarium control); there is no exercise, training or reloading arm, so the requested exercise effect is not identifiable. Independently, each unloading group is a single pooled isolation of 8 animals (S2.2.p4), so rep1/rep2 are culture replicates and the unloading effect is aliased with the isolation/expansion batch (one biological unit per group, n=2 per group x differentiation cell).

candidates.value: LRT ~ diff + grp (paper's unloading time course)
candidates.reason_rejected: estimand is unloading/disuse, not exercise; and group is aliased with the single pooled isolation per group

candidates.value: HS7 vs C and HS14 vs C Wald contrasts treated as 'inactivity vs exercise'
candidates.reason_rejected: the control is ordinary cage activity, not exercise; relabelling the sign would manufacture an exercise contrast the study did not run

design.reasoning: S2.1.p2 groups are Contr/HS7/HS14 only; GEO treatment column has Control and Hindlimb suspension only. The paper's own framing (S1.p3, S4.p3) is functional unloading. Exercise appears only in cited background. Per the skill, a sample set without an exercise arm is refused at design. The pooling (S2.2.p4) would additionally make any unloading inference pseudoreplicated.

discrepancies.paper: RNA-seq described on second-passage FAPs (S2.8.p1); d0/d3 differentiation not mentioned for RNA-seq
discrepancies.data: GEO has d0 and d3 adipogenic-differentiation samples for each group
discrepancies.disposition: recorded; not acted on because the case stops at design

discrepancies.paper: 8 animals per group combined before expansion (S2.2.p4)
discrepancies.data: 2 replicates per group x day labelled rep1/rep2
discrepancies.disposition: replicates are technical/culture replicates of one pool; contributes to the refusal
